scope: The ten books entire. Held for the ledger of the books (3.25), Gaius (3.28), Papias's two Johns (3.39), the Irenaeus sentence in Greek (3.18; 5.8), and Dionysius of Alexandria on Nepos and the Apocalypse (7.24–25).
why_seated: The record through which the date (Irenaeus), the second John (Papias), the dispute over author and standing (Gaius, Dionysius) and the book's double entry in the ledger (3.25) reach every later stratum: strata 3.2–3.4 of Secondary Source.
